# Visual Math Calibration Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Native execution is preserved; the author implements each task and one fresh reviewer checks the whole result.

**Goal:** Deliver one authentic, visually engaging normal-distribution lesson bundle generated by a reusable authoring path, with a protected review URL.

**Architecture:** Add an opt-in visual-deck contract and renderer beside the existing lesson formats. Trusted mathematical recipes, source assets and server-side preview checking support slides, homework and games; the existing Codex engine creates the structured bundle. Preserve existing publications and default generation, and calibrate this one bundle before another ten.

**Tech Stack:** Existing TypeScript/SvelteKit/Node22, HTML/SVG, KaTeX, Codex CLI, native browser motion and existing browser-test harness; no new service subscription.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-10-visual-math-calibration-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- The approved pilot is90 minutes, roughly20–30 meaningful slides, three-unit35372, and an introductory synthetic learner who knows percentages and averages.
- Summer2025 questionnaire35372 question3 is the worked source; fresh independent tasks,10–15 minutes of homework and two short concept games complete the bundle.
- Preserve website logo, blue/slate/white identity, Heebo, friendly Hebrew, RTL and mathematical LTR islands.
- Presenter notes, independent answer keys and unreleased solutions stay outside audience JSON/HTML.
- Review previews write no customer scores, submissions or progress. Existing customers and baseline/v2 corpora remain intact; default generation remains1.
- Raw private reference decks and complete Ministry PDFs stay untracked. Use only a verified question excerpt and its provenance.
- The readiness-question/reuse proposal remains deferred. No questionnaire, automated reuse engine or unrelated refactor.

## Review Focus

- School-band percentages at non-half-step points must not be invented; standard-score calculations such as1.75 remain supported without a false probability (Task1).
- A draggable model and its caption/formula must agree after changes and backward navigation, including reduced motion (Task2 browser checks).
- Student/projector HTML must not contain private notes or answer keys; hints/reveal must not create independent success (Tasks1–2).
- Malformed generated nested arrays, unknown sources and changed source bytes must fail before packaging; failed assembly must preserve prior artifacts (Tasks1/3).
- Source crops, mathematics and interactive controls must remain readable on screen/phone and print; generated content must demonstrate actual visual variety (Tasks2/4).

## Task 1: Visual bundle contract, mathematical models and verified source

**Files:** `src/lib/learning/deck/model.ts`, `normal.ts`, `schema.ts`; `src/lib/server/lesson/official-questions.ts`, `official-question-assets.json`; `tests/unit/visual-deck.test.mjs`, `tests/visual-deck-fixture.mjs`.

**Interfaces:** `VisualLesson` contains version/ruleVersion/title/subtitle/durationMin/homeworkMinutes/objectives/agenda/slides/tasks/homework/games/sourceSolutions. `DeckSlide` contains id/title/kicker/prompt/objectiveId/layout/blocks/taskId/presenterNotes. Blocks are bounded copy/equation/model/source/callout with reveal stages; layouts are cover/visual/split/compare/source/working/challenge/recap. `NormalModel` has mode, interactive, showProbability and staged numeric states. Tasks have unique IDs, complete givens, an optional model and private number/choice/region checks, hints and solutions. `visualLessonProblems(raw,context?)`, `publicVisualLesson(bundle)`, `normalVisual(model,stage?,scope?)` and `gradeDeckTask(task,input)` are the shared contracts. The normal helper is self-contained and returns SVG/caption/formula/percent; it can be serialized into the browser runtime.

- [x] Add a valid synthetic fixture and a RED test for a20–30-slide bundle beyond the historical12-scene cap. Implement validation without changing historical `learningProblems`.
- [x] RED→GREEN school-band math:16% above1s,93% below1.5s, symmetric bands, changed center/spread, and no probability at1.75s. Reject nonfinite/invalid model values and malformed nested objects safely.
- [x] RED→GREEN numeric/choice/region grading and an explicit public allowlist that strips notes, solutions, answer keys and unknown properties.
- [x] RED→GREEN trusted multi-part source/provenance. Add the verified35372 record and a readable question-only crop; keep it out of the legacy single-number generator. Verify document/crop hashes and profile identity.
- [x] Run `node --test tests/unit/visual-deck.test.mjs tests/unit/official-questions.test.mjs`; commit.

## Task 2: Varied slide compositions, teaching guide, homework and visual games

**Files:** `src/lib/server/visual-deck-render.ts`, `src/lib/learning/deck/styles.ts`, `runtime.ts`, `src/lib/server/visual-pilot.ts`, `src/lib/server/learning-pilot-corpus.json`; `src/routes/app/learning-pilot/+server.ts`, `src/routes/api/learning-pilot/+server.ts`; `tests/unit/visual-deck-render.test.mjs`, `tests/characterization/visual-pilot.test.mjs`, `tests/browser/visual-pilot.mjs`.

**Interfaces:** `renderVisualDeck(bundle,{view,gameId?,baseUrl?})` renders lesson/presenter/homework/game views. Server review state is bounded, short-lived and isolated from the DB; `previewAction(session,task,action,input,eventId)` records attempts/support/reveal and returns graded feedback or a requested hint/solution. The authenticated endpoint selects tasks only from the current packaged bundle. `mountVisualDeck(config,normalVisual)` owns navigation/builds, linked model controls, responsive activities and print preparation; it receives only public projections.

- [x] Run affected unit/HTTP/browser checks and build/typecheck; commit.

## Task 3: Reusable authoring rules, real generation and sealed packaging

**Files:** `src/lib/learning/deck/rules.ts`, `src/lib/server/lesson/visual-generation.ts`, `scripts/generate-visual-pilot.mjs`, `scripts/package-visual-pilot.mjs`; canonical learning-iteration skill/guides; `tests/unit/visual-generation.test.mjs`.

**Interfaces:** `generateVisualLesson({context,sourceIds,model?,timeoutMs?})` uses the existing Codex spawn/structured-output/engine-error boundaries. It returns a validated `VisualLesson`, attaches authoritative context in provenance and permits one targeted bad-output retry. Runner manifests record model/effort/CLI/rules/schema/source fingerprints/latency/hashes with a source-integrity seal. Packaging accepts a verified immutable generation and atomically writes the single candidate corpus after revalidation. Default booking generation is not changed.

- [x] RED→GREEN an inert-CLI generation test covering actual schema/rules, authoritative context, invalid nested output and bounded repair; auth/quota/timeouts do not retry.
- [x] Build prompts from the revised shared rules/guides: storyboard purpose, varied composition, mathematical visual recipes, exact source treatment, friendly notes and fresh practice. Match the actual renderer's capabilities; do not request unsupported illustration or grading.
- [x] RED→GREEN packaging provenance, changed bytes/source, invalid flags and preserving an existing destination on failure. Add explicit candidate timeouts without changing production defaults.
- [x] Update and validate the canonical skill, synchronize its installed copy, and record the reference-comparison workflow. Run generation-boundary/packaging checks; commit.

## Self-review and execution

All spec requirements map to Tasks1–4. The separate contract avoids stretching legacy12-scene semantics; pure model/projection/check functions connect generation and renderer; preview sessions preserve disclosure without writing customer records. Actual renderer comparison and original-source inspection are required in addition to automated checks. Native execution and standing integration authorization are preserved; the approved design is the binding brief, not another permission round.
